LanguageData.CC_GodR3_Newborn_Text: The newborn {KIND} born out in the frost last night is alive and warm this morning. The snow in a wide ring round it and its mother is trodden flat, as if something large had lain round them through the night.
LanguageData.CC_GodR3_Newborn_Text_2: The {KIND} born in the snow during the night came through it warm. All round it and its mother the snow is pressed down in a wide ring, as if something big had curled up round them until morning.
LanguageData.CC_GodR3_Newborn_Text_3: At dawn the newborn {KIND} was found warm beside its mother out in the snow, in the middle of a wide ring where the snow had been trodden flat. Nobody of the colony was out there in the night.
LanguageData.CC_GodR3_Saw_Newborn: {WHO} found the newborn {BEAST} warm out in the snow at {HOME}, in a wide ring of trodden snow, as if something had lain round it all night.
LanguageData.CC_GodR3_Ripen_Text: In the noon heat the air over the {FIELD} shimmered, and the whole of the {CROP} there is ripe at once, days before it should have been. It is ready to bring in.
LanguageData.CC_GodR3_Ripen_Text_2: The {CROP} in the {FIELD} was still a few days from ripe this morning. At noon the heat shimmered over it, and now every plant in the field is ready to harvest.
LanguageData.CC_GodR3_Ripen_Text_3: The heat at noon lay over the {FIELD} until the air shimmered, and by the time it eased the {CROP} was ripe from one end of the field to the other.
LanguageData.CC_GodR3_Saw_Ripen: {WHO} saw the {FIELD} at {HOME} ripen all at once in the noon heat, days before its time.
LanguageData.CC_GodR3_FoxfireNight_Text: {PAWN_nameDef} saw a soft green light lying over the ground {PLACE} in the dark, low and still.
LanguageData.CC_GodR3_FoxfireNight_Text_2: A pale green light is lying low over the wet ground {PLACE}, and {PAWN_nameDef} has stopped to look at it.
LanguageData.CC_GodR3_FoxfireNight_Text_3: In the dark {PAWN_nameDef} noticed a green glow on the ground {PLACE}, too faint to be a fire and not moving.
LanguageData.CC_GodR3_Saw_Foxfire: {WHO} saw a soft green light lying over the ground {PLACE} at {HOME} in the night.
LanguageData.CC_GodR3_Foxfire_Text: The green light that lay over the ground {PLACE} in the night is gone with the dawn, and where it was the soil is dark and rich, the kind anything will grow in.
LanguageData.CC_GodR3_Foxfire_Text_2: At first light the glow on the ground {PLACE} faded, and the soil it lay on has turned dark and rich overnight.
LanguageData.CC_GodR3_Foxfire_Text_3: The ground where the soft green light lay {PLACE} through the night is dark, loose and rich this morning.
LanguageData.CC_GodR3_Saw_RichSoil: {WHO} found the ground {PLACE} at {HOME} dark and rich in the morning, where the green light had lain in the night.
LanguageData.CC_GodR3_Saw_PipNight: {WHO} saw sparks and a small light at the bench where the {THING} lay at {HOME}, in the small hours with nobody there.
LanguageData.CC_GodR3_Finished_Text: The {THING} left half made at the bench last night is nearly finished this morning. Nobody worked on it in the night.
LanguageData.CC_GodR3_Finished_Text_2: Most of the work left on the {THING} at the bench has been done since last night, though nobody of the colony was at it.
LanguageData.CC_GodR3_Finished_Text_3: Yesterday the {THING} at the bench was far from done. This morning there is only a little work left on it, and nobody says they did it.
LanguageData.CC_GodR3_Saw_Finished: {WHO} found the {THING} at the bench at {HOME} nearly finished in the morning, though nobody had worked on it in the night.
LanguageData.CC_GodR3_Tide_Text: Under the full moon the sea has come up the shore {PLACE} further than anyone has seen it, over the empty sand, and {PAWN_nameDef} is watching it.
LanguageData.CC_GodR3_Tide_Text_2: {PAWN_nameDef} saw the sea come up over the sand {PLACE} tonight, much further than it ever comes, with the full moon bright on the water.
LanguageData.CC_GodR3_Tide_Text_3: The full moon is up, and the sea has crept up the shore {PLACE} well past its usual line. {PAWN_nameDef} noticed the water where there is usually dry sand.
LanguageData.CC_GodR3_TideBack_Text: At first light the sea went back down the shore {PLACE}, and the sand is as it was.
LanguageData.CC_GodR3_TideBack_Text_2: The water that came up the shore {PLACE} under the full moon has gone back with the dawn.
LanguageData.CC_GodR3_TideBack_Text_3: With the dawn the sea drew back off the sand {PLACE} to where it always is.
LanguageData.CC_GodR3_Saw_Tide: {WHO} saw the sea come up the shore {PLACE} at {HOME} under the full moon, further than it had ever come.
LanguageData.CC_GodR3_Glory_Text: Out in the morning fog, {PAWN_nameDef} saw a huge shadow standing on the mist with a ring of colours round its head. It moved when {PAWN_pronoun} moved, and {PAWN_pronoun} has stopped to look at it.
LanguageData.CC_GodR3_Glory_Text_2: {PAWN_nameDef} has stopped in the morning mist: a giant shadow stands in it, with rings of colour round its head, and it raised its arm when {PAWN_pronoun} raised {PAWN_possessive}.
LanguageData.CC_GodR3_Glory_Text_3: In the fog on the high ground {PAWN_nameDef} saw {PAWN_possessive} own shadow thrown huge onto the mist, a ring of light round its head, and stood still watching it.
LanguageData.CC_GodR3_Saw_Glory: {WHO} saw a giant shadow on the morning mist at {HOME} with a ring of colours round its head, which moved as {WHO} moved.
